            continue

        expanded = expand_leading_tab(line, 3)
        expanded = expand_tab(expanded)
        if expanded.startswith(spaces):
            item_lines.append(expanded[continue_width:])
            end_pos += len(line) + 1
            continue

        indent = len(line) - len(line.lstrip())
        if indent < continue_width and line.strip():
            state.cursor = end_pos
            break

        item_lines.append(line)
        end_pos += len(line) + 1
    else:
        state.cursor = end_pos

    item_text = '\n'.join(item_lines)
    item_text = strip_end(item_text) + '\n'

    has_blank = '\n\n' in item_text

    if has_blank:
        token['tight'] = False

    child_state = state.__class__()
    child_state.src = item_text
    child_state.cursor = 0

    if marker[-1] in ('.', ')'):
        attrs = {'index': int(marker[:-1])}
    else:
        attrs = {}

    list_item_token = {
        'type': 'list_item',
        'children': [],
        'attrs': attrs,
    }

    block.parse(child_state, rules)
    list_item_token['children'] = child_state.tokens
    token['children'].append(list_item_token)

    return next_groups


def _is_loose_list(tokens: Iterable[Dict[str, Any]]) ->bool:
    for token in tokens:
        if token['type'] == 'blank_line':
            return True
    return False
